name: ChatGPT for Word
desc: The same ChatGPT add-in, now drafting and revising inside Word.
desc_zh: 同一个 ChatGPT 加载项，现在能在 Word 里起草和修改文档。
solves: Drafting in a chat tab and pasting into Word loses formatting and tracked changes. The sidebar writes into the document you already have open.
solves_zh: 在聊天窗口里写完再粘进 Word，格式和修订记录都会丢。侧边栏直接写进你已经打开的那份文档。
best_for: Notes need turning into a document, or a draft needs tightening in place.
best_for_zh: 要把笔记变成一份文档，或者就地改紧一份草稿。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes and OpenAI news）。 Ships through the same Microsoft add-in as ChatGPT for Excel and ChatGPT for PowerPoint; the release notes describe the rollout under September 17, 2026. OpenAI publishes no Word-specific help article, so the announcement page that carries the GA date is used as the entry page. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在文字处理软件里的 ChatGPT，与账本对 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/astra-for-law
